title: I really like this new feature gpt has. it can run the game and test it, screenshot inside the game on its own.
author: EverythingBOffensive
selftext: for this one in particular to work, gpt kept telling me it had to install panda3d into the environment to test it before sending me my results. so i told it to install it and it did, and showed exactly how my game looks in a screenshot. This saves so much trouble I can develop games from my phone now.

comments.author: Ohgood9002
comments.body: Just wrapping my head around how to use GPT to assist me. What exactly is your workflow? Trying to get my own footing

replies.author: EverythingBOffensive
replies.body: its great just ask it whatever you want and it will tell you the easiest ways to do it. If its just python stuff it can do a whole lot without any external tools.

comments.author: kal101246
comments.body: Can you share how this works? were you building something in unity and then connected with MCP and asked it to run the code to update it, then test?

replies.author: HerbertGoon
replies.body: I use strictly python its like its own engine and launcher in a single game file. Gpt introduced me to it and panda3s which is pythons 3d renderer. It downloads and generates its own assets. With the new gpt it basically has its own computer to test on. It can generate impressive apps in a single vague prompt and show you the interface before the results if ye ask.

comments.author: jakobpinders
comments.body: How did you ask it to test it?

replies.author: EverythingBOffensive
replies.body: me just asked if it could test stuff out and it told me what it needed, it was able to get what it needed on its own ye just gotta tell it. But I think it varies on what it is you are making, if it can be launched on its own or with python, ur good to go.

comments.author: IAmhowlshot
comments.body: If anyone is confused, it is a python file and the web gpt can run python files inside the chats, makes it great to work on the go!
